recipes.note: Exact project-archived OpenHistoricalMap vector state is used as a low-confidence geometry substrate only after blob pinning and independent source controls agree with the cumulative Moscow state by +1533. The raw OHM 1521 start is not promoted by this recipe; verified operational coverage begins only at 1533-12. The broader 1485–1521 archive feature was explicitly rejected for the +1505 milestone because its interval geometry already incorporates changes occurring inside that interval.
